en.bdb: Superiority of the kaliyuga, in the dark age

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਫੇੜੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satijug utam aakheeaai ik feRai sabh dhes dhuhelaa|

en.bdb: Satyuga is said to be best but in it one committed sin and the whole country suffered.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਿਧੁੰਸੁ ਕੁਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: tretai nagaree peeReeaai dhuaapur va(n)s vidhu(n)s kuvelaa|

en.bdb: In treta, one did the wrong act and the whole city would suffer.  In Duapar, sinful act of one person made the whole family suffer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug sach niaau hai jo beejai so lunai ikelaa|

en.bdb: The justice of Kaliyuga is true because in it only he reaps who sows the evil seeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham sabadh surat satigur gur chelaa|

en.bdb: Brahm is the perfect Sabdabrahm and that disciple who merges his consciousness in the Sabdabrahm is in fact Guru and the true Guru (God).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: naam dhaan isanaan dhiraR saadhasa(n)gat mil a(n)mirat velaa|

en.bdb: Sabdabrahm, the Guru is attained in the holy congregation by remembering the name of the Lord in the ambrosial hours.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhenaa sahij suhelaa|

en.bdb: A mild spoken, humble and giver through his hands moves in equipoise and remains happy.
Ever new love of devotion to the Lord keeps the gurmukhs happy.
